title: Les fonctions résurgentes, Tome I: Les algèbres de fonctions résurgentes
note: Founding text of resurgence theory: the Borel transform, alien derivatives $\Delta_\omega$, the bridge equation relating alien and natural derivations, and lateral/median resummation of transseries. Cited for the identification of the standard-part reduction of a transseries on a Stokes ray with median resummation, and as the canonical home of the alien calculus used in the resurgence-utilization audit.
